# FAQ

### What is an MCP App?

An MCP tool whose definition points to a `ui://` HTML template (`_meta.ui.resourceUri`). The host (Claude, VS Code, Goose, ChatGPT…) draws the template in a sandboxed iframe, sends it the tool's input and result over JSON-RPC `postMessage`, and relays the view's requests (tool calls, links, messages) back. Spec: [`io.modelcontextprotocol/ui`, 2026-01-26](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps/blob/main/specification/2026-01-26/apps.mdx).

### MCP UI vs MCP Apps?

"MCP UI" is the community project ([mcpui.dev](https://mcpui.dev)) that pioneered UI resources; MCP Apps is the official extension that grew out of it. mcp-ui's client now speaks MCP Apps too. vue-mcp-apps targets MCP Apps.

### Do I need Nuxt or Nuxt UI?

No. Cards are Vue 3 components; Nuxt UI is optional and runs as a Vue plugin. Any component library works, or none — the bundle inlines whatever CSS your cards import.

### Can I use React or Svelte?

The **server kit** only needs a bundle `{ script, css, cards }`; build your view however you like and speak the protocol (e.g. with ext-apps' `App`). `@vue-mcp-apps/view` and the native `<McpCard>` are Vue-only.

### Does the same card really run in my app and in Claude?

Yes. `<McpCard>` renders the component directly in your Vue app; the bundle runs the same component in the host's iframe. Both go through `CardRenderer`, so a click means the same thing in both.

### What happens in a host without MCP Apps support?

It ignores the template and shows the tool's text `content`. Always write a useful text in `kit.result(name, props, text)`.

### Why is a card limited to declared actions?

Props come from tool results, which may contain data an attacker influenced (an email, a web page). If a card could call any tool by name, poisoned props could trigger anything. With actions as data, an event can only ever run the tool the manifest names for it.

### How do I make a tool that only the card can call?

`kit.registerTool(server, 'apply_changes', { card: 'approval-card', visibility: ['app'], … }, handler)`. Hosts hide it from the model and allow it from the card.

### Can a card fetch data?

Only from origins declared in its manifest: `resource: { csp: { connectDomains: ['https://api.example.com'] } }`. Prefer calling a tool of your own server instead (a `tool` action) — it goes through the host's checks and works offline-first.

### How big is a template?

The demo bundle is about 290 kB of script and 190 kB of CSS (Vue + Nuxt UI + three cards), inlined in every template. Hosts cache resources; per-card bundles are on the roadmap.

### Can I keep secrets in props?

No. Props travel through the host, stay in the conversation history and are readable by anyone who can inspect the iframe. Use an opaque id and fetch on the server.

### Does the AI demo send my data anywhere?

Chrome built-in AI, WebLLM and Scripted run entirely in your browser. The OpenAI-compatible provider sends the conversation only to the endpoint you configure. See [AI_DEMO.md](AI_DEMO.md).

### Why does the playground need `localhost` and not `127.0.0.1`?

The sandbox proxy is served from the *other* hostname so it lands on a different origin, like a real host. On a single-origin deployment (GitHub Pages) the playground uses an opaque sandbox instead.

### Is this an official MCP project?

No. It builds on the official spec and SDK (and tests against the official `AppBridge`), but it is an independent MIT project.

### Which MCP SDK version?

Server helpers work with SDK v2 (`@modelcontextprotocol/server`) and v1 (`@modelcontextprotocol/sdk`). The example and playground use v2.


================================================================================
FILE: docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md
================================================================================

# Troubleshooting

Start with the workbench's **Protocol** tab: it shows every message between host and view and every host decision. Most problems are visible there in one line.

## The view

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Inspector shows `ui/initialize` and a `response`, but never `ui/notifications/initialized` | The host's response could not be posted: `DataCloneError` (a Vue reactive proxy in `hostContext`, tool input or result) | Send plain JSON: `JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x))` / `toPlain(x)`. The playground logs `send failed` when this happens. |
| A card button does nothing; the view says "Did not work: DataCloneError" | The card emitted a `ref`/`reactive` value | `cardActionFor` copies payloads with `toPlain`; rebuild the bundle with a current `@vue-mcp-apps/core`. |
| "Nothing to show." under an empty card | The result has no `structuredContent.card` and no plain-object `structuredContent`, or the card name is not in the bundle | Return `kit.result(name, props, text)`; check `cards: Object.keys(manifest)` and rebuild. |
| "Unknown card "x"" | The manifest has the card but `components` does not | Add it to `components.ts`. |
| The card stays on "Loading…" | No `tool-result` arrived, or the template card differs from the result's card | Check the inspector for `ui/notifications/tool-result`; a template only draws its own card on the first result. |
| Icons are blank inside the iframe | Iconify tried to fetch from its API; the CSP blocked it | `ui({ icon: { clientBundle: { scan: true } } })` and install `@iconify-json/<collection>`. |
| Unstyled card in the iframe | `cards.json` has `css 0 kB` | Use `@vue-mcp-apps/vite` with `enforce: 'post'` (current version) and rebuild its `dist` when developing it; import your CSS in `view.ts`. |
| Dark mode does not apply | Nuxt UI `colorMode` is on (reads localStorage) or the host sends no `theme` | `ui({ colorMode: false })`; the runtime toggles `.dark` from `hostContext.theme`. |
| Card fonts differ from the host | Expected: the host's `--font-sans` is applied only when it sends `styles.variables` | Choose a *Host styles* preset in the workbench to test. |
| Iframe height jumps or stays tiny | The view measures `body`; margins or `100vh` layouts confuse it | Avoid `h-screen` in cards; let content define height. |

## Clicks and tools

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ⛨ `tools/call refused … not visible to apps` | The tool's `visibility` is `['model']` | Add `'app'` (or omit visibility: default is both). |
| ⛨ `model call refused … app-only` | The model (or *Play the model*) called a `visibility: ['app']` tool | Intended: only a card may call it. |
| A link does nothing | Not http(s) — `safeLinkUrl` drops `javascript:`, `data:`, relative URLs | Emit an absolute http(s) URL. |
| `message` / `context` does nothing | Empty text, or the host lacks the capability | Emit non-empty text; check `hostCapabilities.message` / `updateModelContext`. |
| An event is ignored | Not listed in the manifest's `actions` | List it — unlisted events ask for nothing, by design. |

## Build and tooling

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Failed to resolve entry for package "pkce-challenge"` | `resolve.conditions` replaced Vite's defaults | `conditions: ['vue-mcp-apps:source', ...defaultClientConditions]`. |
| `vue-tsc` errors inside `node_modules/@internationalized/date/src` | A bare `source` condition resolves third-party TS sources | Use the namespaced `vue-mcp-apps:source`. |
| "A card bundle is one script; got N chunks" | A dynamic `import()` in a card or its dependencies | Import statically. |
| "Card bundle is N kB, over maxSizeKb" | Heavy dependency in a card | Trim it, or raise `maxSizeKb`. |
| Bundle freshness test fails | A card / `packages/view` / `packages/core` changed after the last build | `npm run build:cards`. |
| `PLAYGROUND_BASE=/x/` becomes `C:/Program Files/Git/x/` (Git Bash) | MSYS path conversion | Prefix with `MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1`. |
| Shell scripts arrive empty on Windows | Line-ending/autocrlf tooling | Check `git diff` before committing. |

## Playground and hosts

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Proxy layer never turns green | Page opened at `127.0.0.1` while Vite only answers one name, or a blocked port | Open `http://localhost:5173`; or pick *Proxy origin: opaque*. |
| "view not ready … after 10 s" | The template is not an MCP App (no bridge), or a script error in the view | Open DevTools on the `about:srcdoc` frame; check the console. |
| Remote mode: CORS error or 403 | The server does not allow the page's origin | Add it to `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` (demo) / your CORS allowlist. |
| Hot reload does a full page reload | `onBundleUpdate` points at another `cards.json` specifier | Accept the same specifier you import in `project.ts`. |
| claude.ai cannot reach a local server | It needs public https | Tunnel (`cloudflared tunnel --url http://localhost:3001`). |
| Claude Desktop shows text, not the card | Old client, or the tool has no `_meta.ui.resourceUri` (bundle missing at server start) | Update the client; make sure `cards.json` exists before starting the server. |

## AI demo

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Chrome built-in AI shows `unavailable` | Browser/hardware/flags | Check `chrome://on-device-internals`; use WebLLM or Scripted. |
| WebLLM: "WebGPU not available" | Browser or GPU without WebGPU | Recent Chrome/Edge on desktop; or another provider. |
| WebLLM out of memory | Model too large for the GPU | Pick Llama 3.2 1B or Qwen2.5 0.5B. |
| "unusable reply … the scripted rules answer instead" | The small model produced invalid JSON or a wrong tool | Expected now and then; a larger model or clearer tool descriptions help. |
| OpenAI-compatible: `Failed to fetch` | CORS on the endpoint | Ollama: `OLLAMA_ORIGINS=<page origin> ollama serve`; LM Studio: enable CORS. |


================================================================================
FILE: skills/vue-mcp-apps/SKILL.md
================================================================================

---
name: vue-mcp-apps
description: Build, extend and test MCP Apps (MCP UI, the io.modelcontextprotocol/ui extension) written as native Vue components with the vue-mcp-apps libraries (@vue-mcp-apps/core, view, server, vite). Use it when creating or editing an interactive card for an MCP tool with Vue or Nuxt UI; when registering ui:// template resources or shaping tool results with structuredContent.card; when mounting cards natively with <McpCard> or inside a host iframe with startMcpApp; when building the single-file card bundle (cards.json); when testing views against the official AppBridge, a sandbox proxy, or the vue-mcp-apps playground (native pane, three-layer MCP App pane, protocol inspector); or when debugging a card that does not render, does not initialize, or whose buttons do nothing.
---

# vue-mcp-apps

## Mental model

A **card** is a Vue SFC: props come in, events go out, and the card knows nothing about MCP. A frozen **manifest** (`defineCards`) declares what each event *means*:

| Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `tool` | Call a declared tool. |
| `link` | Open an http(s) URL. |
| `notify` | Show a line under the card. |
| `message` | Post a user message to the chat. |
| `context` | Update the model's context. |

The same component runs in two hosts:

1. **Native:** `<McpCard>` mounts it inside your own Vue app. There is no iframe.
2. **MCP App:** the server publishes `ui://cards/<name>`, an HTML template with one inlined script and stylesheet built by `@vue-mcp-apps/vite`. A host (Claude, VS Code, Goose, ChatGPT, the playground) frames it in three layers: host → sandbox proxy (another origin) → view. Inside the view, `startMcpApp` speaks the MCP Apps protocol.

Tools return `kit.result(name, props, text)`. That puts `structuredContent.card = { name, props }` in the result for the view, and `content` text for the model. A card click becomes `tools/call`, and the host proxies it to the server.

## File map

```
packages/core/src/cards.ts       defineCards, cardActionFor, resultCard, toPlain, safeLinkUrl, cardUri, eventListenerProp
packages/core/src/protocol.ts    METHODS, MCP_APP_MIME, MCP_APPS_EXTENSION, HostContext & wire types, clientSupportsMcpApps, resultText
packages/view/src/bridge.ts      McpAppBridge — the view side of the protocol, dependency-free
packages/view/src/app.ts         startMcpApp — the iframe runtime (handshake, result → card, actions, size)
packages/view/src/McpCard.ts     <McpCard> — native host
packages/view/src/renderer.ts    CardRenderer — the one place events become CardActions (used by both hosts)
packages/view/src/context.ts     useCardHost() — read-only { mode, hostContext, toolInput, streaming, busy }
packages/view/src/theme.ts       applyHostContext, NUXT_UI_TOKENS
packages/server/src/index.ts     createCardServerKit, cardTemplateHtml, cardToolMeta, cardResult, …
packages/vite/src/index.ts       defineCardBundleConfig, mcpCardBundle (enforce: 'post') → cards.json
examples/demo-cards/             manifest.ts, components.ts, cards/*.vue, view.ts, vite.cards.config.ts, server/{createServer,stdio,http}.ts
playground/src/project.ts        THE file that says which cards/server the playground tests
playground/src/lib/sandboxHost.ts  host layer on the official AppBridge (policy + logging)
playground/public/sandbox.html   the sandbox proxy (layer 2), copyable into any host
playground/src/pages/            DemoPage (#/ AI chat) · WorkbenchPage (#/workbench)
playground/src/ai/               AI demo: types.ts (AiProvider, Decision) · prompt.ts (systemPrompt, decisionSchema, parseDecision) · agent.ts (send, PROVIDERS, modelTools) · providers/{chrome,webllm,openai,scripted}.ts
e2e/                             Playwright end-to-end tests (npm run test:e2e)
.github/workflows/               ci · e2e · pages · release · codeql (+ dependabot.yml)
AGENTS.md · llms.txt · llms-full.txt   AI-friendly entry points (npm run docs:llms regenerates llms-full.txt)
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md · INTEGRATION.md · WRITING_CARDS.md · PLAYGROUND.md · AI_DEMO.md · TESTING.md · CI_CD.md · FAQ.md · TROUBLESHOOTING.md · GLOSSARY.md
references/protocol.md · references/api.md   (next to this file)
```

## Recipe: add a card (6 steps)

1. **Manifest.** In `manifest.ts`, add `'my-card': { title, description, actions: { evt: { kind: 'tool', tool: 'my_tool' }, … }, fixtures: { default: {…} } }`. The name is kebab-case with a dash.
2. **Component.** Write `cards/MyCard.vue`:
   - `defineProps` for the data;
   - `defineEmits` with exactly the event names from the manifest;
   - the first emitted argument is the payload: an object for `tool`, a URL for `link`, text for `message` / `context` / `notify`;
   - optionally `useCardHost()` for `busy`, `mode`, `hostContext` and `toolInput`.
3. **Register.** Add `'my-card': MyCard` to `components.ts`. The view bundle and native hosts both import it.
4. **Server.** Return the card from a tool:
   - `kit.registerTool(server, 'show_my', { card: 'my-card', inputSchema, description }, async args => kit.result('my-card', props, 'what the model should read'))`;
   - a tool that only the card may call gets `visibility: ['app']`.
5. **Build.** `npm run build:cards`, or `npm run dev`, which watches. The card name must be in `cards: Object.keys(manifest)`.
6. **Verify.** In `npm run dev` → http://localhost:5173:
   - draw the card from a fixture, edit its props, click in **both** panes;
   - then "play the model" with the real tool;
   - read the Protocol tab;
   - run `npm test` (the bundle freshness test fails until `cards.json` is rebuilt).

## Extending the libraries: invariants to keep

- **Actions are data.** A tool action always runs the tool *declared* in the manifest, never a name sent by the card. Do not add a `callTool` to `useCardHost()` or to card props. New action kinds go in `CardActionSpec`, `defineCards` validation, `cardActionFor`, both hosts (`app.ts`, `McpCard.ts`) and the docs.
- **Payloads are plain JSON.** Everything that crosses `postMessage` goes through `toPlain`, or a JSON copy on the host side. Vue proxies throw `DataCloneError`.
- **A template fetches nothing.** One inline script and one inline stylesheet, bundled icons, no fonts, no dynamic `import()`. The CSP stays empty unless a card declares `resource.csp`.
- **One bundle, one source hash.** `cards.json` holds `{ generatedBy, versions, sourceHash, sources, cards, script, css }`. Keep `mcpCardBundle` at `enforce: 'post'`.
- **The view bridge stays spec-exact and dependency-free.** Method names come from `METHODS`. Trust only `event.source === window.parent`. Answer `ping` and `ui/resource-teardown`; answer unknown requests with `-32601`. The test `packages/view/src/bridge.test.ts` plays it against the official `AppBridge`, so keep it green.
- **The server kit stays SDK-agnostic.** It only uses `registerTool` and `registerResource` (`ServerLike`). `packages/server/src/server.test.ts` runs it against a real SDK v2 `McpServer` and `Client`.
- **Workspace resolution uses the custom condition `vue-mcp-apps:source`**, never a bare `source`:
  - Vite: `resolve.conditions: ['vue-mcp-apps:source', ...defaultClientConditions]`;
  - tsconfig: `customConditions`;
  - tsx: `--conditions=vue-mcp-apps:source`.
- Config files load packages from `dist`. After editing `packages/vite`, run `npm run build:packages` before building cards.

## Integrating into another project

Full guide with copy-pasteable files: `docs/INTEGRATION.md`. In short:

- **Cards package** exports `manifest` (pure data, imported by every side), `components` (browser sides) and `dist/cards.json` (server only).
- **Server**: `createCardServerKit({ manifest, bundle })` on SDK v2 (`@modelcontextprotocol/server`, `inputSchema: z.object(...)`) or v1 (`@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/mcp.js`, raw zod shape). HTTP: `createMcpHandler(factory)` + `toNodeHandler` (Node/Express) or `.fetch(request)` (edge). Keep state outside the factory; CORS allowlist for browser hosts.
- **Nuxt 4 app**: `modules: ['@nuxt/ui']`, `build.transpile: ['my-cards']`, `@source` the cards folder in the CSS, render `<McpCard>` in a `.client.vue` component with `call-tool` wired to the app's MCP client; `message` actions → next chat turn, `context` → next prompt.
- **Plain Vue**: `ui({ scanPackages: ['my-cards'] })` + `app.use(ui)`.
- **Unknown cards from other servers**: be a host — `AppBridge` + the copyable `playground/public/sandbox.html` on another origin; `playground/src/lib/sandboxHost.ts` is the reference.
- **Migrating a hand-rolled system** (Facturador's `CARD_ACTIONS`/`card-host.ts`/`mcp-app/*`/`api/mcp-apps.ts`): mapping table in `docs/INTEGRATION.md#11-migrating-a-hand-rolled-card-system`. Note the payload moves to the FIRST emitted argument and `tag` → `name` (`uriPrefix` keeps old URIs).

## The AI demo (`#/`)

An in-browser assistant picks a **model-visible** tool (`modelTools()`: visibility includes `"model"`), the host calls it, and the card appears in the chat as a sandboxed MCP App (or natively). Card `ui/message` → next user turn (`fromCard`); `ui/update-model-context` → `chat.modelContext`.

- Providers (`AiProvider`): `chrome` (Prompt API `LanguageModel`, Gemini Nano, `responseConstraint`), `webllm` (`@mlc-ai/web-llm` in a Web Worker; Qwen2.5-1.5B default, Llama-3.2-1B, Qwen2.5-0.5B), `openai` (OpenAI-compatible, native `tools`; Ollama default `http://localhost:11434/v1`, `qwen2.5:3b`), `scripted` (rules; always available; fallback).
- Decision JSON: `{"action":"call_tool","tool":<enum>,"arguments":{}}` | `{"action":"answer","text":"…"}`; `parseDecision` validates tool + required args, else `DecisionError` → scripted fallback.
- Add a provider: implement `AiProvider` with the `prompt.ts` helpers, register in `PROVIDERS`. Providers never touch MCP, the host or cards.
- Details: `docs/AI_DEMO.md`.

## Testing

- `npm test`: vitest, covering the core contract, the bridge against `AppBridge` over fake windows, the server kit over `InMemoryTransport`, and bundle freshness.
- `npm run typecheck`: `tsc -b` for the packages, `vue-tsc` for the example and the playground.
- Playground by Playwright. The view is two frames deep:
  ```js
  const view = page.frameLocator('iframe[title="Sandbox proxy"]').frameLocator('iframe[title="MCP App view"]')
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Weather in Madrid' }).click()
  await view.getByRole('button', { name: 'Refresh' }).click()
  // inspector rows: page.locator('ol li')
  ```
- End to end: `npm run test:e2e` (Playwright, `e2e/`): three layers, card clicks, scripted AI chat. Never use WebLLM/Chrome AI in CI.
- CI/CD: `ci.yml` (build, freshness, unit, typecheck, playground build), `e2e.yml`, `pages.yml` (GitHub Pages, `PLAYGROUND_BASE=/<repo>/`), `release.yml` (tag `v*` → npm publish with provenance when `NPM_TOKEN` is set), `codeql.yml`, `dependabot.yml`. See `docs/CI_CD.md`.
- Official CLI probe: `npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector --cli <server cmd> --method tools/call --tool-name get_weather --tool-arg city=Madrid --app-info` → `hasApp: true`.
- Official inspector (Apps tab): `npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector npx tsx --conditions=vue-mcp-apps:source examples/demo-cards/src/server/stdio.ts`.
- Remote: `npm run server:http` → `http://localhost:3001/mcp`. Use it with the playground's *Remote* mode, ext-apps' `basic-host`, or MCPJam.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Cause → fix |
| --- | --- |
| View shows "Loading…" forever; the log has `ui/initialize` and a response but no `ui/notifications/initialized` | The host's `postMessage` threw `DataCloneError`: a Vue reactive proxy is inside `hostContext`, the tool args or the result. JSON-copy everything you send (the playground's `plain()`); the inspector logs it as **send failed**. |
| Card shows "Did not work: DataCloneError … could not be cloned" | The card emitted reactive state (for example a `ref([])`) and something bypassed `toPlain`. Emit plain data, and keep `toPlain` in `cardActionFor`. |
| Build reports `css 0 kB` | `mcpCardBundle` ran before Vite's CSS plugin. It must be `enforce: 'post'`. If you changed it, rebuild `packages/vite` (configs load `dist`). |
| Icons missing; the console shows CSP / `api.iconify.design` blocked | Icons must be bundled: `ui({ icon: { clientBundle: { scan: true } } })` plus the `@iconify-json/<set>` package. |
| `Failed to resolve entry for package "pkce-challenge"` (or another dependency) in Vite | `resolve.conditions` replaced the defaults. Use `['vue-mcp-apps:source', ...defaultClientConditions]`. |
| `vue-tsc` errors inside `node_modules/@internationalized/date` (or another package's raw `.ts`) | A bare `source` condition. Use the namespaced `vue-mcp-apps:source`. |
| Card not drawn; status says "Nothing to show." or shows the text | The result has no `structuredContent.card`; or the card name is not in `cards.json` (rebuild); or the template is for another card (a template draws its own card first). |
| Button does nothing | The event name is not listed in the manifest (no listener is bound), or a `link` payload is not http(s), or a `message` / `context` payload is empty. |
| "Refused by host: tool is not visible to apps" | The tool's `_meta.ui.visibility` lacks `'app'`. Register it with `visibility: ['model', 'app']`, or leave the option out. |
| Model cannot call a tool | It is `visibility: ['app']` (card-only), which is by design. |
| Native pane: "no native component" | Add the component to `project.components` (`playground/src/project.ts`) and its folder to `@source` in `playground/src/style.css`. |
| Sandbox pane blank on `127.0.0.1` | Open `http://localhost:5173`: the proxy uses the other host name to get a second origin. |
| AI demo: "unusable reply … scripted rules answer instead" | A small model produced invalid JSON / unknown tool / missing args. Expected sometimes; improve tool descriptions or use a larger model. |
| AI demo: OpenAI-compatible `Failed to fetch` | Endpoint CORS: `OLLAMA_ORIGINS=<page origin> ollama serve`; LM Studio → enable CORS. |
| `PLAYGROUND_BASE=/x/` became `C:/Program Files/Git/x/` | Git Bash path conversion: `MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1`. |
| Dark mode wrong inside the view | The bundle must use `ui({ colorMode: false })`. The theme comes from `hostContext.theme` (the `.dark` class). |

More: `references/protocol.md` (every MCP Apps message and field) and `references/api.md` (every export).


================================================================================
FILE: skills/vue-mcp-apps/references/api.md
================================================================================

# API reference

Every export of the four packages, as defined in `packages/*/src`. `@vue-mcp-apps/view` also re-exports all of `@vue-mcp-apps/core`.

## @vue-mcp-apps/core

### Cards (`cards.ts`)

```ts
type CardActionSpec =
  | { kind: 'tool'; tool: string }        // args = first emitted arg if a plain object, else {}
  | { kind: 'link' }                      // first arg, http(s) only
  | { kind: 'notify'; fallback?: string } // first arg (string) or fallback or event name; second arg = data
  | { kind: 'message' }                   // first arg as text → ui/message
  | { kind: 'context' }                   // first arg as text → ui/update-model-context

type JsonSchema = Record<string, unknown>

interface CardSpec {
  title: string
  description?: string
  actions?: Record<string, CardActionSpec>
  propsSchema?: JsonSchema
  fixtures?: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>>
  resource?: {
    csp?: { connectDomains?: string[]; resourceDomains?: string[]; frameDomains?: string[]; baseUriDomains?: string[] }
    permissions?: Record<string, Record<string, never>>
    prefersBorder?: boolean
  }
}

type CardManifest<Names extends string = string> = Readonly<Record<Names, Readonly<CardSpec>>>

function defineCards<const T extends Record<string, CardSpec>>(cards: T): CardManifest<Extract<keyof T, string>>
  // validates kebab-case names, titles and action kinds; freezes everything
function isCardName(manifest: CardManifest, name: unknown): name is string
function cardTools(manifest: CardManifest): string[]          // sorted allowlist of every tool any card may call

interface CardPayload { name: string; props: Record<string, unknown> }
function plainObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown>
function resultCard(result: unknown): CardPayload | null      // reads structuredContent.card

type CardAction =
  | { kind: 'tool'; event: string; tool: string; args: Record<string, unknown> }
  | { kind: 'link'; event: string; url: string }
  | { kind: 'notify'; event: string; message: string; data: Record<string, unknown> }
  | { kind: 'message'; event: string; text: string }
  | { kind: 'context'; event: string; text: string }

function safeLinkUrl(value: unknown): string | null           // http(s) href or null
function toPlain<T>(value: T): T                              // JSON copy (no proxies, functions, Dates → strings)
function cardActionFor(manifest: CardManifest, name: string, event: string, args: readonly unknown[]): CardAction | null
function eventListenerProp(event: string): string             // 'foo-bar' | 'fooBar' → 'onFooBar'
function cardUri(name: string, prefix = 'ui://cards/'): string
```

### Protocol (`protocol.ts`)

```ts
const MCP_APPS_EXTENSION = 'io.modelcontextprotocol/ui'
const MCP_APPS_PROTOCOL_VERSION = '2026-01-26'
const MCP_APP_MIME = 'text/html;profile=mcp-app'
const LEGACY_RESOURCE_URI_META_KEY = 'ui/resourceUri'
const METHODS: {
  initialize, openLink, message, updateModelContext, requestDisplayMode, callTool, readResource,
  initialized, sizeChanged, log,
  toolInput, toolInputPartial, toolResult, toolCancelled, hostContextChanged,
  resourceTeardown, sandboxProxyReady, sandboxResourceReady
}  // the method strings; see protocol.md

type JsonRpcId = string | number
interface JsonRpcMessage { jsonrpc: '2.0'; id?; method?; params?; result?; error?: { code; message; data? } }
interface ContentBlock { type: string; text?: string; [k: string]: unknown }
interface CallToolResult { content?: ContentBlock[]; structuredContent?: Record<string, unknown>; isError?: boolean; _meta? }
type DisplayMode = 'inline' | 'fullscreen' | 'pip'
interface HostContext { theme?; styles?; displayMode?; availableDisplayModes?; containerDimensions?; locale?; timeZone?;
                        userAgent?; platform?; deviceCapabilities?; safeAreaInsets?; toolInfo?; [k: string]: unknown }
interface HostCapabilities { openLinks?; serverTools?; serverResources?; updateModelContext?; message?; logging?; … }
interface InitializeResult { protocolVersion; hostInfo?; hostCapabilities; hostContext }
interface ResourceCsp { connectDomains?; resourceDomains?; frameDomains?; baseUriDomains? }
interface ResourcePermissions { camera?; microphone?; geolocation?; clipboardWrite? }
type ToolVisibility = 'model' | 'app'

function clientSupportsMcpApps(capabilities: unknown): boolean  // extensions (or experimental) lists our mime
function resultText(result: CallToolResult | null | undefined): string
```

## @vue-mcp-apps/view

interface StartMcpAppOptions {

}
interface McpAppHandle { bridge: McpAppBridge; app: App; card: Ref<CardPayload | null>; unmount(): void }

### `McpAppBridge` (`bridge.ts`)

```ts
interface BridgeHandlers {
  onToolInput?(args); onToolInputPartial?(args); onToolResult?(result: CallToolResult)
  onToolCancelled?(reason?: string); onHostContextChanged?(context: HostContext); onTeardown?(): void | Promise<void>
}
interface BridgeOptions { requestTimeoutMs?: number /* 30000 */; availableDisplayModes?: DisplayMode[] }

class McpAppBridge {
  constructor(handlers: BridgeHandlers, options?: BridgeOptions, host: Window = window.parent, self: Window = window)
  hostCapabilities: HostCapabilities; hostContext: HostContext; hostInfo?: { name; version }
  connect(appInfo): Promise<InitializeResult>        // ui/initialize → ui/notifications/initialized
  close(): void
  request(method: string, params: unknown): Promise<unknown>
  notify(method: string, params: unknown): void
  callTool(name, args): Promise<CallToolResult>
  readResource(uri): Promise<{ contents: … }>
  openLink(url): Promise<unknown>
  sendMessage(text): Promise<unknown>               // ui/message, role 'user'
  updateModelContext(text, structuredContent?): Promise<unknown>
  requestDisplayMode(mode): Promise<{ mode }>
  sizeChanged(width, height): void
  log(level: 'debug'|'info'|'warning'|'error', data, logger = 'vue-mcp-apps'): void
}
```

Trusts only `event.source === host`. Answers `ping` and `ui/resource-teardown`, and answers anything else with `-32601`. If `postMessage` throws, it retries with a JSON copy.

### Native hosting

// McpCard.ts
const McpCard: Component<{

  result?: CallToolResult | null; card?: CardPayload | null       // card wins

  callTool?: (name: string, args: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<CallToolResult>
  handleLinks?: boolean   // default true: window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer')
  showStatus?: boolean    // default true
}>  // emits: action(CardAction), result({ action, result }), error({ action, error })

const NUXT_UI_TOKENS: Readonly<Record<string, string>>
  // --color-background-primary → --ui-bg, -secondary → --ui-bg-muted, -tertiary → --ui-bg-elevated, -inverse → --ui-bg-inverted

## Playground AI demo (not a package — `playground/src/ai/`)

The contract to implement or extend the demo assistant. Providers turn text into a decision; `agent.ts` does MCP, host checks and cards.

```ts
// types.ts
interface ToolSpec { name: string; description: string; inputSchema: Record<string, unknown> }   // model-visible tools only
type Decision =
  | { action: 'call_tool'; tool: string; arguments: Record<string, unknown> }
  | { action: 'answer'; text: string }
interface Turn { role: 'user' | 'assistant' | 'tool'; text: string; tool?: string; fromCard?: boolean }
interface DecideContext { turns: Turn[]; tools: ToolSpec[]; modelContext: string[] }
type ProviderState = 'unavailable' | 'downloadable' | 'downloading' | 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error'
interface ProviderStatus { state: ProviderState; detail?: string; progress?: number }
type ProviderId = 'chrome' | 'webllm' | 'openai' | 'scripted'
interface AiProvider {
  id: ProviderId; label: string; blurb: string
  check(): Promise<ProviderStatus>                                   // cheap, never downloads
  load(onStatus: (s: ProviderStatus) => void): Promise<void>         // may download
  decide(context: DecideContext): Promise<Decision>
  answerAfterTool(context: DecideContext & { tool: string; resultText: string }): Promise<string>
}

// prompt.ts
toolSignature(tool: ToolSpec): string                 // get_weather(city: string, unit?: "C" | "F")
systemPrompt(tools: ToolSpec[]): string
transcript(context: DecideContext, maxTurns = 8): string
decisionSchema(tools: ToolSpec[]): Record<string, unknown>   // tool: enum of tool names
ANSWER_SCHEMA                                          // { text: string }
afterToolPrompt(tool: string, resultText: string): string
parseDecision(raw: string, tools: ToolSpec[]): Decision      // throws DecisionError
extractJson(raw: string): string
parseAnswer(raw: string): string
class DecisionError extends Error

// agent.ts
PROVIDERS: Record<ProviderId, AiProvider>
chat                                                   // reactive: items, turns, modelContext, providerId, status, busy, thinking
modelTools(): ToolSpec[]
refreshStatuses(), selectProvider(id), loadProvider(id?), autoPick()
send(text: string, options?: { fromCard?: boolean }): Promise<void>
addModelContext(text: string): void
resetChat(): void
```

WebLLM models (`providers/webllm.ts`, `WEBLLM_MODELS`): `Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct-q4f16_1-MLC` (default), `Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-q4f16_1-MLC`, `Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct-q4f16_1-MLC`. OpenAI-compatible config (`openaiConfig`): `baseUrl`, `model`, `apiKey` (memory only).

# MCP Apps protocol reference

This covers the `io.modelcontextprotocol/ui` extension, spec **2026-01-26**, as implemented by `@modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps` 2.x. The wire protocol is identical between ext-apps 1.x and 2.x.

Sources:

- https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps/blob/main/specification/2026-01-26/apps.mdx
- the `specification/draft/` folder of the same repository.

## Discovery

- **Client capability:**

  ```json
  { "capabilities": { "extensions": { "io.modelcontextprotocol/ui": { "mimeTypes": ["text/html;profile=mcp-app"] } } } }
  ```

  Use `clientSupportsMcpApps(caps)` to check it.

- **Tool definition `_meta`:**

  ```json
  { "ui": { "resourceUri": "ui://cards/x", "visibility": ["model", "app"] }, "ui/resourceUri": "ui://cards/x" }
  ```

  - The flat `ui/resourceUri` key is deprecated; it is kept for older hosts.
  - `visibility` defaults to `["model", "app"]`.
  - `["app"]` hides the tool from the model.
  - A host must refuse an app's `tools/call` on a tool without `"app"`. App-only tools are never callable across servers.

- **Template resource:**
  - `mimeType: "text/html;profile=mcp-app"`;
  - `_meta.ui` = `{ csp?, permissions?, domain?, prefersBorder? }`;
  - `_meta.ui` may sit on the `resources/list` entry or on the `resources/read` content item; the content item wins.
    - `csp`: `{ connectDomains?, resourceDomains?, frameDomains?, baseUriDomains? }`
    - `permissions`: `{ camera?, microphone?, geolocation?, clipboardWrite? }`, each `{}`. These map to the iframe's `allow` attribute; apps must feature-detect.
    - `domain`: a dedicated sandbox origin; its format is host-defined.

- **Tool result:** `content` is for the model; `structuredContent` is for the view. In vue-mcp-apps, `structuredContent.card = { name, props }`.

## View → host

| Method | Type | Params | Result |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui/initialize` | request | `{ appInfo: {name, version}, appCapabilities: { availableDisplayModes?, tools? }, protocolVersion }` | `{ protocolVersion, hostInfo, hostCapabilities, hostContext }` |
| `ui/notifications/initialized` | notification | `{}` | — |
| `tools/call` | request | `{ name, arguments }` | `CallToolResult` (proxied to the view's own server) |
| `resources/read` / `resources/list` | request | standard MCP | standard MCP |
| `ui/open-link` | request | `{ url }` | `{}` |
| `ui/message` | request | `{ role: 'user', content: ContentBlock[] }` | `{ isError? }` |
| `ui/update-model-context` | request | `{ content?: ContentBlock[], structuredContent? }` | `{}` |
| `ui/request-display-mode` | request | `{ mode: 'inline' \| 'fullscreen' \| 'pip' }` | `{ mode }` (granted) |
| `ui/notifications/size-changed` | notification | `{ width, height }` | — |
| `notifications/message` | notification | `{ level, logger?, data }` | — |
| `ping` | request | `{}` | `{}` |
| `ui/download-file` | request (draft) | file payload | — |
| `ui/notifications/request-teardown` | notification (draft) | `{}` | — |

## Host → view

| Method | Type | Params |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui/notifications/tool-input-partial` | notification (0..n) | `{ arguments }`, the arguments as streamed so far |
| `ui/notifications/tool-input` | notification (exactly once, before the result) | `{ arguments }` |
| `ui/notifications/tool-result` | notification | `CallToolResult` |
| `ui/notifications/tool-cancelled` | notification | `{ reason? }` |
| `ui/notifications/host-context-changed` | notification | the changed `hostContext` fields only |
| `ui/resource-teardown` | request | `{}` → the view answers `{}` |
| `ping` | request | `{}` |
| `tools/call`, `tools/list` | request (draft) | app-provided tools |

The host must not send anything to the view before `ui/notifications/initialized`. The host may forward any method that does not start with `ui/` to the MCP server, or block it, or ask the user first.

## hostContext

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `toolInfo` | `{ id?, tool: Tool }` |
| `theme` | `'light' \| 'dark'` |
| `styles` | `{ variables?: Record<CssVar, string>, css?: { fonts?: string } }` |
| `displayMode` | `'inline' \| 'fullscreen' \| 'pip'` |
| `availableDisplayModes` | `DisplayMode[]` |
| `containerDimensions` | `{ height \| maxHeight, width \| maxWidth }` |
| `locale` | BCP 47 string (for example `es-ES`) |
| `timeZone` | IANA string |
| `userAgent` | string |
| `platform` | `'web' \| 'desktop' \| 'mobile'` |
| `deviceCapabilities` | `{ touch?, hover? }` |
| `safeAreaInsets` | `{ top, right, bottom, left }` |

### Style variable names (`styles.variables`)

- **Colours:** `--color-{background,text,border,ring}-{primary,secondary,tertiary,inverse,ghost,info,danger,success,warning,disabled}`. The ring family has primary, secondary, inverse, info, danger, success and warning only.
- **Fonts:**
  - `--font-sans`, `--font-mono`
  - `--font-weight-{normal,medium,semibold,bold}`
  - `--font-text-{xs,sm,md,lg}-{size,line-height}`
  - `--font-heading-{xs,sm,md,lg,xl,2xl,3xl}-{size,line-height}`
- **Shape:** `--border-radius-{xs,sm,md,lg,xl,full}`, `--border-width-regular`, `--shadow-{hairline,sm,md,lg}`

vue-mcp-apps mirrors a subset onto Nuxt UI tokens (`NUXT_UI_TOKENS`, see `api.md`).

## hostCapabilities

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `openLinks` | `{}` |
| `downloadFile` | `{}` |
| `serverTools` | `{ listChanged? }` |
| `serverResources` | `{ listChanged? }` |
| `logging` | `{}` |
| `sandbox` | `{ permissions?, csp? }` |
| `updateModelContext` | modalities, for example `{ text: {} }` |
| `message` | modalities, for example `{ text: {} }` |
| `sampling` | `{ tools? }` |
| `experimental` | `{}` |

## Web hosts: the sandbox proxy

1. The host page frames a **proxy** on a **different origin**, with `sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin"` (plus `allow-forms` in practice).
2. The proxy sends `ui/notifications/sandbox-proxy-ready` (`{}`).
3. The host sends `ui/notifications/sandbox-resource-ready`: `{ html, sandbox?, csp?, permissions? }`. `sandbox` overrides the inner iframe's sandbox attribute.
4. The proxy creates the inner view iframe, with the CSP from `csp` and `allow` from `permissions`. It then relays every message except `ui/notifications/sandbox-*`, and creates no requests of its own.

basic-host:

- uses `allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-forms` for the inner iframe;
- serves the CSP as an HTTP header;
- builds `allow` with `buildAllowAttribute(permissions)` from `@modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps/app-bridge`.

The vue-mcp-apps playground proxy (`playground/public/sandbox.html`) injects the CSP as a `<meta>` instead.

**Default CSP when there is no `ui.csp`:**

```
default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline';
img-src 'self' data:; media-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'none'
```

With `csp` declared:

- `resourceDomains` is added to `script-src`, `style-src`, `img-src`, `font-src` and `media-src`;
- `connectDomains` is added to `connect-src 'self'`;
- `frame-src` is `frameDomains`, otherwise `'none'`;
- `object-src 'none'` always;
- `base-uri` is `baseUriDomains`, otherwise `'self'`.

A host must not allow domains that were not declared.

## Official SDK names (ext-apps 2.0.x)

- **`App` (view side):**
  - Events: `ontoolinput`, `ontoolinputpartial`, `ontoolresult`, `ontoolcancelled`, `onhostcontextchanged`, `onteardown`.
  - Methods: `callServerTool`, `sendMessage`, `openLink`, `updateModelContext`, `requestDisplayMode`, `getHostContext`, `sendSizeChanged`.
- **`AppBridge` (host side):**
  - Constructor: `new AppBridge(client|null, hostInfo, hostCapabilities, { hostContext })`.
  - Sending to the view: `sendToolInput`, `sendToolInputPartial`, `sendToolResult`, `sendToolCancelled`, `setHostContext`, `teardownResource`, `sendSandboxResourceReady`.
  - Event setters: `oninitialized`, `onsandboxready`, `onsizechange`, `oncalltool`, `onopenlink`, `onmessage`, `onupdatemodelcontext`, `onrequestdisplaymode`, `onreadresource`, `onloggingmessage`.
  - `setHostContext` sends only the changed fields.
- **`PostMessageTransport(eventTarget, eventSource)`:** listens on `window` and checks `event.source`.
- **Server helpers** (`/server`): `registerAppTool`, `registerAppResource`, `RESOURCE_MIME_TYPE`, `RESOURCE_URI_META_KEY`, `EXTENSION_ID`, `getUiCapability`.
- **Peer dependencies:** `@modelcontextprotocol/client|core|server@^2`, `zod@^4.2`.

## Hosts that render MCP Apps

- Claude (claude.ai and Desktop)
- VS Code ≥ 1.109
- Goose
- ChatGPT
- Postman
- MCPJam Inspector
- the mcp-use inspector
- the official MCP Inspector ≥ 0.20 (Apps tab)
- ext-apps `examples/basic-host` (the reference host)

# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report vulnerabilities **privately** through GitHub: *Security → Report a vulnerability* on [JuanmanDev/vue-mcp-apps](https://github.com/JuanmanDev/vue-mcp-apps/security/advisories/new). Do not open a public issue. You will get an acknowledgement within a few days; fixes are released as patch versions with an advisory.

Supported versions: the latest `0.x` release.

## Threat model in brief

MCP Apps put UI built from **tool results** — data that may contain attacker-influenced text (an email, a web page, a ticket) — inside an assistant that can run tools. vue-mcp-apps is designed so that poisoned data cannot turn a card into a tool-calling weapon.

| Risk | Mitigation |
| --- | --- |
| A card's props trick it into calling a dangerous tool | **Actions are data.** The manifest (`defineCards`, frozen) maps each event to one action; a `tool` action always runs the declared tool. Unlisted events are ignored. |
| The model calls a tool that should need a human | **Visibility.** Card-only tools carry `_meta.ui.visibility: ['app']`; hosts hide them from the model and refuse model calls. Hosts refuse view calls to tools without `'app'`. |
| The view reaches the host's cookies, storage or DOM | **Sandbox + other origin.** Hosts frame a sandbox proxy on another origin (or an opaque one), which frames the view in `srcdoc` with a CSP built from `_meta.ui.csp`. |
| The view exfiltrates data | **Templates fetch nothing** by default (`connectDomains: []`). Cards that must fetch declare origins explicitly. |
| A forged message reaches the view | `McpAppBridge` only accepts messages whose `source` is `window.parent`. |
| Links to `javascript:` / `data:` URLs | `safeLinkUrl` allows http(s) only. |
| Script injection through inlined code | Templates escape `</script`, `</style` and `<!--` (`inlineSafe`); titles and names are HTML-escaped. |
| Secrets leaking through props | Never put secrets in props: they travel through the host and stay in the conversation. Pass opaque ids. |
| Any website calling a local HTTP server | The demo HTTP server uses a CORS **allowlist** (`ALLOWED_ORIGINS`) and answers 403 to other browser origins. |
| API keys in the AI demo | The OpenAI-compatible provider keeps its key in the tab's memory only and sends it only to the endpoint you typed. Chrome built-in AI, WebLLM and Scripted keep everything in the browser. |

Hosts built on vue-mcp-apps (or copying `playground/src/lib/sandboxHost.ts`) must keep the visibility checks in `oncalltool`, serve the proxy from another origin, and send plain JSON only.

# Changelog

All notable changes to this project are documented here. The format follows [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/) and the project uses [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/).

## [Unreleased]

## [0.1.0] — 2026-10-15

First public version, extracted from the card system of Facturador / Hotelier Tools.

### Added

- **`@vue-mcp-apps/core`**: `defineCards` (frozen manifest, validated names and actions), `cardActionFor` with five action kinds (`tool`, `link`, `notify`, `message`, `context`), `resultCard`, `toPlain`, `safeLinkUrl`, `cardUri`, `cardTools`, `eventListenerProp`, MCP Apps protocol constants and wire types, `clientSupportsMcpApps`, `resultText`.
- **`@vue-mcp-apps/view`**: `McpAppBridge` (dependency-free view side of the spec, with request timeouts), `startMcpApp` (iframe runtime: handshake, host context, streamed input, result → card, actions, card swap, size reporting, localized status line), `<McpCard>` (native host), `CardRenderer`, `useCardHost()`, `applyHostContext` and `NUXT_UI_TOKENS`.
- **`@vue-mcp-apps/server`**: `createCardServerKit` (templates, tool `_meta`, visibility, results; works with MCP SDK v1 and v2), `cardTemplateHtml`, `cardResourceMeta`, `cardToolMeta`, `toolVisibilityMeta`, `cardResult`, `asCardBundle`, `inlineSafe`.
- **`@vue-mcp-apps/vite`**: `defineCardBundleConfig` / `mcpCardBundle` (one IIFE + CSS → `cards.json`, size limit, source hash), `sourceHash`.
- **Example `demo-cards`**: weather, change approval (card-only `apply_changes`) and poll (card-only `cast_vote`) cards with Nuxt UI; one server for stdio, HTTP (CORS allowlist) and the browser.
- **Playground**: AI chat demo (`#/`) with Chrome built-in AI, WebLLM, OpenAI-compatible and scripted providers, cards inline as sandboxed MCP Apps or natively; three-layer workbench (`#/workbench`) on the official `AppBridge` with sandbox proxy, inspector, fixtures, live props editing, host settings and hot reload.
- **Tests**: core contract, renderer, protocol conformance against ext-apps' `AppBridge`, server kit against the SDK v2 server/client, bundle freshness, Playwright end-to-end.
- **CI/CD**: CI, E2E, GitHub Pages, release (npm with provenance), CodeQL, Dependabot.
- **Docs**: README, integration, architecture, writing cards, playground, AI demo, testing, CI/CD, FAQ, troubleshooting, glossary; `AGENTS.md`, `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`; Claude Code skill and plugin.

[Unreleased]: https://github.com/JuanmanDev/vue-mcp-apps/compare/v0.1.0...HEAD
[0.1.0]: https://github.com/JuanmanDev/vue-mcp-apps/releases/tag/v0.1.0
